notes.title: 🎓 Season 2 – Development Update & Early Previews 🎓
notes.notes:
Development of University Days: Season 2 is moving full speed ahead!



Episode 1 & Episode 2 are now complete.

Episode 3 is in the final stages and will be released soon.



To celebrate, here’s an early look at a few previews from Episodes 1–3. Expect fresh drama, new choices, returning favorites, and plenty of ways to get yourself into (or out of) trouble this semester.



📸 Click the below button to check out the previews on Season 2's community page — and don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game on Steam so you’ll be the first to know when the game goes live.
